theater: 瓦斯普拉坎阿瓦拉爾平原

battle.name: 阿瓦拉爾戰役
battle.theater: 瓦斯普拉坎阿瓦拉爾平原
battle.brief: 451年，薩珊波斯與瓦爾丹·馬米科尼揚率領的亞美尼亞貴族聯軍，在瓦斯普拉坎的阿瓦拉爾平原決戰。波斯以戰象與重騎兵破陣，瓦爾丹陣亡、聯軍崩潰，但自身損失慘重，未能禁止亞美尼亞的基督教信仰。卡面羅馬標槍為晚期羅馬重裝步兵的標準刺槍，此役並無羅馬部隊參戰，它標示的正是密集步兵以短刺槍迎戰象群的戰法。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 阿瓦拉爾之戰是451年薩珊波斯與亞美尼亞基督教聯軍在高加索戰區的一場正面決戰，交戰雙方的組織方式截然不同。波斯一方以國王雅茲底格爾二世為最高統帥，戰場指揮由薩珊王朝高加索戰區的老將穆什坎·尼烏薩拉烏爾特率領，兵種包括帕提亞式的重裝騎兵團「斯帕赫」、索格底亞與阿拉伯籍的步兵和弓手，以及自印度運來的戰象；軍中另編有約六萬名效忠派亞美尼亞人，即反對馬米科尼揚家的亞美尼亞貴族武裝。亞美尼亞一方則是受基督教信仰維繫的貴族聯軍，由馬米科尼揚家族的瓦爾丹·馬米科尼揚以邦國領袖身份統率，部隊來自斯尤尼克、塔爾溫、萬迪克與阿爾察赫等邦，並有改宗基督教的波斯王子薩珊·瓦漢所部與大批雇傭兵。亞美尼亞的指揮體系以宗族私兵為骨幹，教會提供宗教動員、軍旗與誓約；波斯的指揮體系則是宗主兼馬爾茲班的官僚與貴族混合體系，邊軍由中央支付薪餉與馬匹。羅馬帝國沒有派兵參戰，但使節在兩軍之間往返，亞美尼亞方面把羅馬的態度視為關鍵變數。
countriesEn: The Battle of Avarayr was a set-piece engagement in the Caucasian theatre in 451 between the Sasanian Empire and a Christian Armenian coalition, and the two sides were organised in fundamentally different ways. On the Persian side the overall command lay with King Yazdegerd II, while the field command belonged to Mushkan Niusalavurt, the veteran Sasanian commander in the Caucasian theatre. His army combined Parthian-style heavy cavalry, the spah, Sogdian and Arab foot and archers, and war elephants brought in from India; it also incorporated some sixty thousand so-called loyal Armenians, the armed contingents of the Armenian noble houses opposed to the Mamikonian family. On the Armenian side stood a coalition of Christian nobles held together by religious conviction, led by Vardan Mamikonian of the Mamikonian house, who acted as the effective war leader of the Armenian confederation. Their contingents came from Siwnik, Taron, Vanand and Artsakh, and were joined by the troops of the Persian prince Sasan Vahan, who had converted to Christianity, together with large numbers of hired fighters. Armenian command rested on the private levies of the clan houses, while the Church supplied religious mobilisation, standards and oaths; Persian command was a mixed bureaucratic and aristocratic system, with the frontier army paid and provisioned from the centre. Rome sent no troops to the field, though envoys travelled between the two camps, and the Armenian side treated Rome's disposition as a decisive variable.
people: 瓦爾丹·馬米科尼揚是此役的決定性人物。他是馬米科尼揚家族的領袖，在亞美尼亞的政治與軍事傳統中等同於大公與統兵元帥，同時又被教會視為信仰的守護者。據亞美尼亞方面的說法，他在451年春召集邦國貴族與地方部隊，集合起以萬計的聯軍向波斯挑戰。波斯方面的將領穆什坎·尼烏薩拉烏爾特掌控象兵與重騎兵的指揮；斯尤尼克親王瓦薩克起兵反波斯後歸附瓦爾丹，戰事中被波斯方面視為叛逆並於事後處死；波斯王子薩珊·瓦漢在戰前改宗基督教，率部擔任亞美尼亞軍的左翼。萬迪克侯爵格維翁德是隨軍的見證者兼記錄者，戰後寫下《瓦爾丹的戰爭與亞美尼亞人的流離》，是當代最重要的一手戰記。帕爾皮出身的拉撒路所撰《亞美尼亞史》則保存了戰場的儀式性細節，例如以十字為旗、兩軍隔水對峙的描述。國王雅茲底格爾二世在戰後數年內去世，其子佩羅茲與叔父卡瓦德相繼爭位，薩珊王朝的注意力被迫轉向內部，瓦爾丹的敗仗亦因此沒有招來新一輪的大舉鎮壓。
peopleEn: Vardan Mamikonian was the decisive figure of the campaign. Head of the Mamikonian house, he ranked in Armenian political and military tradition as both the princeps and the commander-in-chief, and the Church likewise regarded him as a guardian of the faith. According to the Armenian account, he summoned the nobles and local levies of the several provinces in the spring of 451 and assembled a coalition numbering many thousands before he moved against Persia. On the Persian side Mushkan Niusalavurt commanded the elephants and the heavy cavalry; Vasak, prince of Siwnik, had risen against Persia and then joined Vardan, and the Persian authorities treated him as a rebel and executed him afterwards; the Persian prince Sasan Vahan converted to Christianity before the battle and led the left wing of the Armenian army. Ghevond, marzban of Vanand, was an eyewitness and a chronicler, and afterwards wrote The War of Vardan and the Migration of the Armenians, the most important contemporary record of the fighting. Lazarus of P'arpi, in his History of the Armenians, preserved the ceremonial detail of the field, such as the raising of the cross as a standard and the description of the two armies confronting each other across the water. Yazdegerd II died within a few years of the battle, and his son Peroz and his uncle Kavadh then fought over the succession, so the attention of the Sasanian state turned inward. For that reason Vardan's defeat was not followed by a fresh and overwhelming punitive campaign.
kits: 羅馬標槍是本作的卡面兵器，設計為半米長、槍桿中空的短刺投槍：槍桿以白楊或榉木挖空，鑲上細長的鐵質槍頭，尾端加配重箍。它的用途並非用來貫穿人體，而是用來壓制——刺進敵盾之後槍桿當場折斷，半截槍留在盾上，使對手既難以拔出，也無法重複使用同一面盾。到451年羅馬帝國尚未滅亡，晚期羅馬軍的《榮譽職官表》仍記載多支部隊以標槍武裝，標槍依然是重裝步兵的標準近身刺槍。需要說明的是，阿瓦拉爾戰場上沒有羅馬部隊出現；實際投入的是亞美尼亞聯軍的密集步兵方陣與波斯的高加索軍。亞美尼亞步兵配長矛「孔托斯」、可投擲的短刺標槍、小圓盾與弓箭，關鍵的附帶裝備還包括火把與易燃油料，用來對付象群；波斯重騎兵「斯帕赫」持長矛與圓盾，步兵以複合弓與短矛為主，另有數十頭印度象，配乘象的箭手、投槍手與腳鐙長矛。雙方都沒有使用攻城器械，這是一場平原上的野戰。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum is the weapon shown on the card. It is a short thrusting javelin about half a metre long with a hollow shaft: the shaft is hollowed out of poplar or beech, fitted with a narrow iron head, and weighted with a lead collar at the butt. Its purpose was not to run through a body but to pin an opponent down, for once the shaft had entered a shield it snapped, and the broken stub left in the shield could not be pulled out easily, so the same shield could not be used again. By 451 the Roman Empire had not yet fallen, and the late Roman Notitia Dignitatum still lists several units as armed with the pilum, which remained the standard close-combat thrust of the heavy infantry. It has to be said that no Roman troops fought at Avarayr; what actually went into the battle was the dense infantry phalanx of the Armenian coalition and the Sasanian army from the Caucasus. The Armenian foot carried the long kontos, throwable short thrusting javelins, small round shields and bows, and their essential ancillary equipment included torches and inflammable material used against the elephants. The Persian heavy cavalry, the spah, used long spears and round shields, the infantry relied on composite bows and short spears, and some dozens of Indian elephants carried riders with bows, javelins and long foot-sword lances. Neither side used siege engines; this was a field battle on open plain.
tactics: 瓦爾丹的部署是典型的步兵居中、兩翼配置騎兵。亞美尼亞聯軍把最密集的步兵方陣放在正面與中央，兩翼騎兵負責掩護側翼；波斯軍則把象群與步兵列於中軍前鋒，重騎兵分置兩翼。交戰的關鍵在於地形：阿瓦拉爾平原因河道與山麓夾峙，可供展開的寬度不足以讓波斯騎兵迂迴包抄，兩翼的機動作戰被壓成正面對撞。波斯象群衝向亞美尼亞中央方陣，試圖以衝撞與踩踏瓦解步兵線；亞美尼亞步兵以密集的刺槍與投射武器應對，並以火把與易燃物反擊，與象兵近身纏鬥。瓦爾丹本人率精銳衝鋒試圖扭轉中央，卻在混戰中被波斯騎兵包圍而陣亡；中央旗幟一倒，方陣出現缺口，全軍當即崩潰，兩翼騎兵亦隨之退走。關於戰後追擊與收兵的細節，各家記載互有出入：有的說波斯騎兵在追擊中被亞美尼亞殘餘騎兵擊退，有的說追擊反而造成更大損失。潰退中的亞美尼亞軍把瓦爾丹的遺體帶回，傷者退往設防城鎮，戰役就此結束。
tacticsEn: Vardan's deployment followed the classic pattern of infantry in the centre and cavalry on both wings. The Armenian coalition packed its densest infantry phalanx into the front and centre, with cavalry on the flanks to cover the sides; the Persian army placed elephants and foot at the head of the centre, with the heavy cavalry out on both wings. The decisive factor was the ground: the Avarayr plain is hemmed in by a river course and the foothills, and the space available for deployment was too narrow for the Persian horse to swing round and outflank, so the manoeuvre on both wings was compressed into a frontal collision. The Persian elephants charged the Armenian central phalanx in an attempt to break the infantry line by weight and trampling; the Armenian foot answered with massed thrusts and missiles, and replied with torches and inflammables, fighting at close quarters against the elephant lines. Vardan himself led a body of picked troops forward to turn the centre, but he was surrounded by the Persian cavalry in the melee and killed. When the central standard went down, a gap opened in the phalanx, the whole army broke at once, and the cavalry on the wings withdrew with it. The accounts differ over the pursuit and the rally afterwards: some say the Persian horse was driven back by the surviving Armenian cavalry, others that the pursuit cost the Persians still more. The broken Armenian army carried Vardan's body away, the wounded were brought back into the fortified towns, and there the campaign ended.
data: 時間有兩說：伊朗百科全書與《晚期古代牛津辭典》把交戰日定在451年5月26日，亞美尼亞方面的說法與中文資料常定於6月2日，地點都在瓦斯普拉坎的阿瓦拉爾平原，約北緯39度20分、東經45度3分，即今伊朗西阿塞拜疆省查伊帕雷縣喬爾斯一帶。兵力方面，亞美尼亞方面的估計為波斯軍約三十萬、另加約六萬效忠亞美尼亞人，象的數目不詳但估為數十頭；亞美尼亞聯軍則記為六萬六千人，另有說法稱其含騎兵一萬二千。這些數字明顯帶有文獻誇張的成分，真實兵力可能遠低於此。陣亡數字同樣只出自亞美尼亞方面的記錄：波斯軍約三千五百四十四人陣亡，亞美尼亞軍約一千零三十六人陣亡；如此懸殊的比例與戰局描述並不吻合，多數研究者視之為單一文獻的孤立說法。距離與時間方面，首都泰西封至戰場直線距離約七百公里，邊軍沿山麓行軍需數十日，後勤以就地徵集與劫掠為主，補給線長而脆弱。
dataEn: Two dates are given: the Encyclopaedia Iranica and the Oxford Dictionary of Late Antiquity place the fighting on 26 May 451, while the Armenian account and Chinese-language sources commonly give 2 June. The site in both cases is the plain of Avarayr in Vaspurakan, at roughly 39 degrees 20 minutes north and 45 degrees 3 minutes east, which is the neighbourhood of Chors in Chaypareh county, West Azerbaijan province, in present-day Iran. On strength, the Armenian estimate is about 300,000 for the Persian army plus some 60,000 loyal Armenians, the number of elephants unknown but estimated in the dozens; the Armenian coalition is recorded as 66,000, with one account putting cavalry among them at 12,000. These figures plainly carry literary exaggeration, and the real armies were likely much smaller. The casualty figures likewise come only from the Armenian side: about 3,544 Persians and about 1,036 Armenians killed. That ratio sits badly with the description of the fighting, and most researchers treat it as an isolated claim from a single document. On distance and time, the capital at Ctesiphon lies about seven hundred kilometres from the battlefield in a straight line, the frontier army needed several weeks to march along the foothills, and supply rested on requisition and plunder on the spot, so the line of communication was long and fragile.
cause: 直接起因是亞美尼亞在428年推翻阿爾達沙克王朝末代君主阿爾達沙克四世，改由波斯冊封並派駐馬爾茲班治理；亞美尼亞貴族起初接受宗主地位，條件是保留基督教的自由。此後雅茲底格爾二世對亞美尼亞教會的自主性心存戒心：亞美尼亞教區在教理上隸屬多尼特教區，而後者與希臘、羅馬的教會同屬一個世界，亞美尼亞一旦被羅馬或拜占庭的教會體系吸納，就會成為帝國內部的隱患。449年佩羅茲王子起兵反叛，波斯腹地捲入內亂；451年西部邊境又告急，宗主需要可靠的邊軍，卻又擔心亞美尼亞貴族趁亂割據。451年春，瓦爾丹以保護信仰與邦國自治為號，召集斯尤尼克、塔爾溫、萬迪克等邦的貴族聯軍公開起兵，把衝突由地方叛亂升級為一場公開的聖戰。亞美尼亞同時向羅馬求援，羅馬使節親赴陣營勸說和談，說明這場衝突在國際層面上已被當作羅馬與波斯角力的一環。
causeEn: The immediate cause lay in 428, when the Armenian nobles deposed Artaxias IV, the last ruler of the Arsacid house, and accepted a Sasanian client king installed by Persia with a marzban to govern them. The nobles accepted overlordship at first on condition that their Christian faith was left free. Yazdegerd II thereafter grew uneasy about the autonomy of the Armenian church, for the Armenian dioceses were, in doctrine, dependent on the see of Dyrrachium, and that see belonged to the same Latin and Greek world as Rome; an Armenia absorbed into the Roman or Byzantine ecclesiastical system would be a danger inside the empire. In 449 the prince Peroz rose in revolt and the interior of Persia was drawn into civil war; in 451 the western frontier was itself in trouble, and the shah needed dependable frontier troops while fearing that the Armenian nobles would use the disorder to break away. In the spring of 451 Vardan called up the noble levies of Siwnik, Taron, Vanand and the other provinces under the banner of defending the faith and the autonomy of the provinces, turning a local rising into a declared holy war. Armenia at the same time appealed to Rome, and Roman envoys came in person to the camp to counsel peace, which shows that the conflict was already being treated internationally as part of the struggle between Rome and Persia.
impact: 此役的直接後果是亞美尼亞在軍事上失敗、在宗教上獲勝。瓦爾丹陣亡被亞美尼亞教會封為聖人，與同陣亡的部眾一起被尊為聖瓦爾丹殉道士，每年的瓦爾丹節至今仍是亞美尼亞教會最重要的節慶之一，亞美尼亞的教會史與學校制度至今仍以這場戰役為核心記憶。戰略上，波斯雖然贏了戰鬥，卻損失慘重，無力乘勝追擊；亞美尼亞的基督教信仰與教會建制得以延續，452年之後戰事再度爆發，亞美尼亞一度淪為波斯的附庸，直到484年，波斯才與瓦爾丹的後人瓦漢簽訂條約，正式承認亞美尼亞教會的自由與馬米科尼揚家族的世襲地位。從長遠看，這場戰役確立了一個模式：亞美尼亞以信仰作為抵抗宗主國的核心武器，此一模式在後世被反覆援引，成為亞美尼亞民族敘事的重要源頭；薩珊王朝此後把注意力轉向內部的皇位繼承與對匈奴、突厥的戰事，高加索前線的壓力相對緩和。
impactEn: The immediate aftermath of the battle was a military defeat for Armenia and a religious victory. Vardan was canonised by the Armenian church and was venerated together with his fallen men as the holy martyrs of Vardan, and the annual feast of Vardan remains one of the most important observances of the Armenian church to this day, with the battle standing at the centre of Armenian church history and schooling. Strategically, the Persians had won the field but had paid dearly, and they had not the strength to press the advantage; the Christian faith and the institutions of the Armenian church survived, the war flared up again after 452, and Armenia fell back into a state of Sasanian dependency until 484, when Persia concluded a treaty with Vardan's kinsman Vahan and formally recognised the freedom of the Armenian church and the hereditary position of the Mamikonian house. In the longer run the battle set a pattern: faith used as the principal weapon of resistance to an overlord, a pattern invoked again and again afterwards and a major source of the Armenian national narrative. The Sasanian state, meanwhile, turned its attention to succession at home and to the wars against the Huns and the Turks, so that the pressure on the Caucasian front eased considerably.
result: 戰術結果毫無疑問屬於波斯。瓦爾丹陣亡，亞美尼亞聯軍在中央被突破之後全面崩潰，再無力反攻。亞美尼亞方面承認失敗，卻把它解釋為信仰的凱旋：波斯的勝仗沒有換來對亞美尼亞教堂的取締，亞美尼亞人仍可自由舉行禮拜，瓦爾丹的名字被寫進教會的聖人傳。波斯得到的則是一場代價高昂的勝利：陣亡數字偏高，亞美尼亞貴族的抵抗意志未被打斷，治理成本反而上升，國王雅茲底格爾二世在戰後沒有多餘的力量把占領變成有效統治。最終的政治結果出現在三十三年後——484年，新王與瓦漢的條約確認亞美尼亞教會的自由與馬米科尼揚家族的自治權，阿瓦拉爾的敗仗才被回頭認作一次划算的失敗：教會存活，主權更替，戰爭勝負並不等於信仰與制度的勝負。
resultEn: The tactical result belonged to Persia without question. Vardan was killed, the Armenian coalition broke up completely once its centre had been pierced, and it had no strength left to counterattack. The Armenian side conceded the defeat, yet interpreted it as a victory of the faith: the Persian win had not produced a suppression of the Armenian church, the Armenians were still free to worship, and Vardan's name was entered among the saints of the church. Persia in turn had won a costly victory. The casualty figures ran high, the resistance of the Armenian nobles was not broken, and the cost of governing the province went up rather than down; after the battle Yazdegerd II lacked the force to turn an occupation into effective administration. The final political settlement came thirty-three years later. In 484 the new king concluded a treaty with Vahan confirming the freedom of the Armenian church and the autonomy of the Mamikonian house, and only then was the defeat of Avarayr recognised in retrospect as a bargain: the church survived, the sovereign changed, and the issue of a war is not the issue of a faith.
